target_text:
// The K tag (token, head, element) is unique per cell, as in t_gof_dma. The K
  // rows are 64-byte aligned: the typed source row states that alignment.
body:
**[comments] Rule 4, comment lines that map to no code line: shorten**

The first sentence restates the declarations at 862-863 (a vector of gof_tokens entries, each NKV rows of HS bf16). The "finite (the largest, 0x37ff, ...)" clause maps to no code line: store_row and load_row are integer scatters and gathers, shuffle_k_head copies bf16 values, and the REQUIRE compares to_bits(), so no step converts to float; the number is also wrong, the largest tag (3<<12)|(7<<8)|127 is 0x377f. The tag-uniqueness line (-> 868) and the alignment line (-> 859 alignas(64) and the k_source_row<HS> default at 880) each carry one fact and stay.

Proposed:
```cpp
  // The K tag (token, head, element) is unique per cell, as in t_gof_dma. The K
  // rows are 64-byte aligned: the typed source row states that alignment.
```
